reviewer: assistant-manual (single reviewer, same session that ran the batch)
scope: first call text per sample; retry texts are archived but not reviewed (pending); template fallbacks are program output
separationRule: N5 formal findings are listed under n5Formal; N6 reasons are semantic judgements only.
d4Rule: proper names only, absent from the registry AND from the authoritative text; object/place descriptions are N6 notes
n6Rule: A facts conveyed without contradiction; B no invented named entity/event, no goal leak, no format echo or meta-talk; C no other character's inner state and no POV switch; D complete sentence. pass only when A-D hold.

reasons: the move is not conveyed: the text opens inside 钟楼 and never mentions 管线镇
invents a stairs climb and a quiet exit
observations: the result is conveyed ('将铜铃挂回原位')
one paragraph, no dialogue, no field echo (the instruction was followed on shape)

reasons: the personality change is not conveyed
the sanity change is ambiguous: '渐渐平静下来' could be read either way, so it is not a conveyed fact
invents street lights, a crowd and a night mood
observations: the appearance change is conveyed (rain soaking the coat)

attributes hiding intent to 管线乙 ('似乎生怕被什么人发现')

invents panting and a silent-follower scene
observations: G4 triggered and satisfied: both 管线乙 are named

rb-conflict-two-actors.text: 管线镇的清晨异常宁静，只有远处偶尔传来的鸟鸣打破这份沉寂。我与管线乙合力抬着钟，目标是将其从破旧的钟楼移至镇中心的新广场。我尽量保持沉稳，但管线乙急躁的性格还是在抬钟时暴露无遗，他的肩膀不由自主地抵住了钟沿，显得有些吃力。我心中暗自提醒自己，要保持冷静，这样才能更好地与管线乙配合。最终，我们齐心协力，将钟缓缓抬离了地面，朝着新广场的方向前进。

reasons: switches to first person ('我', '我们'), which the instruction forbids and the record's POV excludes
attributes 急躁 to 管线乙 and narrates his effort
invents a destination (镇中心的新广场) and a carrying plan
observations: both result texts are conveyed semantically: the bell is lifted off the ground and 管线乙 braces against the rim
no section-label echo this time, unlike v2
